hero.title: Find the Perfect Apartment
hero.lead: Tell us what you are looking for and we do the rest. A member of our team visits each apartment personally, and our service is free to you.

divisions.title: Apartment Rentals
divisions.text: A large database of apartments across Houston and the surrounding areas, each one visited by a licensed agent before it reaches your list.

divisions.title: Townhome Rentals
divisions.text: Privately owned townhomes, with the price, amenities, floor plans and approval criteria written down for you.

divisions.title: Condo Rentals
divisions.text: Privately owned condos throughout the Houston region, matched to your budget, your pet and your move date.

divisions.title: Corporate Relocation
divisions.text: Relocation help for companies operating in the Houston area, including furnished short-term corporate leases.

divisions.title: Corporate Leasing
divisions.text: Leasing for employers who need a good place for their people to stay while they settle in.

divisions.title: Listing Services
divisions.text: Own a rental and need a tenant? List it with us and our agents put it in front of people already looking.

about.title: Agents who have seen the apartment before you do
about.text: Texas Apartment Locators Houston has been in business for more than 11 years, and most of our agents have been locating apartments for more than 25 years. Anyone can read listings online, so our agents visit the properties themselves and report back on price, amenities, floor plans and approval criteria. Call us or drop by the office, and we build a list from a short conversation about what you need. You can tour on your own or we can drive you.
